h1: Commercial relocation services in New York, NJ and Pennsylvania
lead: BRS manages your corporate move from first plan to final close-out, working as an extension of your team to keep disruption to daily operations low.
card_blurb: Relocation project management for corporate moves, from planning through close-out, with minimal disruption.
meta_title: Business Relocation Services in New York | BRS
meta_description: Commercial relocation project management across New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania. MWBE-certified, serving businesses since 1987.
overview: Business Relocation Services Inc. (BRS) plans and manages commercial moves of any type and size. We supplement your internal move team and coordinate any or all parts of the relocation, from the first planning interview to close-out.

We serve corporations, small to large businesses, city agencies and non-profits across New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania. Relocation project management is also available to clients anywhere in the US, with remote and on-site support.
BRS has operated since 1987 and is a certified MWBE. Our team combines experience from the moving industry, corporate facilities management, installation and accounting.

benefits.title: Less disruption to operations
benefits.text: We aim to have your employees working on day one. The cost of a well-run relocation is small next to lost productivity and downtime.

benefits.title: Better use of your budget
benefits.text: Competitive bidding, effective move planning and proven process improvements help control cost.

benefits.title: Shorter move cycles
benefits.text: Detailed move phasing reduces move cycle times and the resource hours a project needs.

included: Initial operations interviews to understand your requirements
Relocation schedule and plan development, with move phasing
Move logistics preparation, coordinating everyone involved
Employee communication before the move and support after it
Moves, adds and changes (MAC) coordination with on-site utility movers
Furniture decommissioning, warehousing, delivery and installation

process.title: Interview and scope
process.text: We start with operations interviews to learn your goals, requirements and constraints.

process.title: Plan and schedule
process.text: We build the relocation plan and phased schedule, and prepare move logistics.

process.title: Coordinate and execute
process.text: Your dedicated project manager coordinates movers, IT and stakeholders and keeps employees informed.

process.title: Close and support
process.text: We close out the project and support employees after the move so they can get back to work.

who_for: Small to large businesses moving to new space
Facilities teams that need extra project management capacity
Companies that need ongoing moves, adds and changes support

faq.q: Can BRS work alongside our internal move team?
faq.a: Yes. We supplement your existing team and can coordinate any or all aspects of the relocation as an extension of your organization.

faq.q: Where do you provide relocation services?
faq.a: We serve New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania from offices in Secaucus, NJ and New York, NY. Relocation project management is available to clients anywhere in the US.

faq.q: What are moves, adds and changes (MAC) services?
faq.a: A MAC team pairs an experienced project manager with utility movers on site. They handle day-to-day moves, furniture in or from storage, PC disconnects and reconnects, deliveries, system furniture repairs and picture hanging.
